Field.Label: Zones are configured in lamplighter.json, under Preferences/Plugins/com.simons-plugins.indigo-lamplighter/ in your Indigo installation folder. The plugin watches the file and reloads it within five seconds of a save; if the new file does not validate, the error is logged and the previous configuration keeps running.
Manage the status page:
Field.Description: Install/update lamplighter.html into Web Assets automatically

Field.Label: On startup (and whenever you save this config with the box ticked), the plugin copies its bundled lamplighter.html into Web Assets/static/pages/ if it is missing or out of date. Untick this if you hand-edit the installed copy - the plugin will otherwise overwrite your changes on the next start or config save. With it unticked the plugin never writes the file, but logs one INFO line when the installed copy differs from the bundled one.
